# turn 1: the words of the account and of the intention.  Written by Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-10-30.
fourth: the one after the third
account: what a person says of a thing, after it
mr: a word before the name of a man
h: the name of a man in the account
m: the name of a man who works for the roofers
b: the name of a man in the account; it is an error for the name of an other man
he: the man this is about
wrote: a word for write, when it is before now
had: a word for have, when it is before now
which: what one
cheque: a thing that says a bank has to give money to a person
worker: a person who works for an other person
working: work, when it is now
roofers: persons who make roofs
threw: a word for throw, when it is before now
tile: a part of a roof
hit: came at a person or a thing
years: more than one year
priors: offences of a person, before now
theft: the offence of taking a thing of an other person
